row:
Devoted to your health & well-being, Dembski Chiropractic provides intuitive chiropractic care and mutational counseling. Dr. Christopher Dembski, Dr. Cassandra Maximenko, and Dr. Jason Stryjewski provide quality chiropractic care to thousands of patients in western Connecticut. Whether you're searching for effective pain relief or a way to boost whole body wellness, Dembski Chiropractic & Rehabilitation can help.
We treat all musculoskeletal injuries, including, but not limited to, neck, back, hip, knee, running and rotator cuff injuries; headaches; tennis elbow; effects of repetitive stress; and plantar fasciitis. There is an emphasis on myofascial therapy and techniques such as the Graston Technique and Active-Release Technique.  Using these methods, we aim to resolve injuries and improve health among our patients. Whether you're searching for effective pain relief or a way to boost whole body wellness, Dembski Chiropractic and Rehabilitation can help.
